<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS data the most intense ion is at m/z 183.0451, which corresponds to a protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈182.0378 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1) suggests the molecule contains about nine carbon atoms. The formula that best fits a monoisotopic mass near 182.04 Da with nine carbons and typical organic elements is C₉H₁₀O₄.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O4</final_answer>
